receipt.stdout:
Usage: agentprof scan [options]

Collect explicit --codex-root/--claude-root inputs only (at least one required)

Options:
  --usage-timing      opt into versioned record timestamps for history --tokens
  --pattern-evidence  capture exact observed errors and supported structured
                      file evidence; includes usage timing
  --reconcile         collect explicit .jsonl files and retain proven missing
                      sources as unavailable
  -h, --help          display help for command

Bounded scan: at most 16 roots, 64 sources, 256 directories, 4096 nodes and yielded entries,
16 MiB/32768 records per source, 256 diagnostic samples. No aggregation or parser resume.
--reconcile requires explicit .jsonl file roots, not directories. Only proven missing leaves are retired; stored evidence remains.
Missing/unreadable parents and symlinks are not deletion evidence. No automatic directory pruning or inferred moves.
